data.title: [Incident Recovered] Zone B Indonesia (Jakarta) Region Network Access Anomaly

eventUpdates.content: 20:20 All affected cloud products have been recovered.
At 19:58, the affected devices were fully recovered, and the affected ECS services are being progressively restored.

Dear Customer,

At 18:39 Beijing Time on March 20, 2026, Alibaba Cloud Monitoring detected an abnormality in cross-domain and cross-zone public network access in Zone B of the Indonesia (Jakarta) region, which caused anomalies in some cloud product services. After urgent intervention by Alibaba Cloud engineers, the affected equipment has been gradually recovered. If you have any further questions, please feel free to contact us at any time.
